title: Proofbench Evidence Bundle Manifest v2
description: Schema for evidence/<runId>/manifest.json: the machine-checkable record of one verification run. All enums, required fields, and types derive from internal/evidence/types.go.

schema.description: Bundle schema version. Must be 2 for evidence bundle v2.

ticket.description: Optional ticket or issue identifier this bundle is attached to (e.g. 'ENG-20190').

claim.description: One-sentence statement of what this run is intended to prove (e.g. 'sync(verse) propagates to sequenceNote on release').

phase.description: Lifecycle stage this bundle documents. One of: repro (reproduce the problem), verify (first verification), reverify (re-check after a fix), fix (the fix run itself), report (summary/rollup).

kind.description: Pairing role within a before/after pair: 'before' or 'after'. Omit when the bundle stands alone.

pairsWith.description: runId of the complementary bundle in a before/after pair. Bundles pair by explicit ID, not by convention.

surface.description: Free-form key-value map describing the execution surface (e.g. substrate, cluster, env). Kept as a flat map so it is substrate-agnostic.

pins.description: Key-value map of exact versions/SHAs for every artifact exercised, making the run reproducible (e.g. repo commit, image digest).

proofLevel.description: Highest proof-ladder rung reached by this bundle. L0=static-valid, L1=builds/loads, L2=unit-green, L3=up+healthy, L4=effect-verified, L5=end-to-end observed.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the run started.

finishedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the run finished (including verdict seal). Omitted if the run was abandoned.

checks.description: Ordered list of machine-evaluated predicate results. Every declared check must appear, using 'not-run' rather than omitting — never default-green.

artifacts.description: Ordered list of all captured files and links in this bundle directory. Set at verdict-seal time; unregistered files are auto-registered.

verdict.description: Overall outcome of the bundle, set last from artifacts and checks. Tri-state: pass (all checks passed), fail (at least one check failed), inconclusive (checks could not run, e.g. a human gate blocked execution).

note.description: Human-readable annotation on the verdict (e.g. reason for inconclusive, override rationale).

Check.title: Check
Check.description: A machine-evaluated predicate result. State is explicitly tri-state — 'not-run' must be used rather than omitting a check that did not execute.

name.description: Unique name of this check within the bundle, matching the corresponding CheckSpec in ready.yaml where applicable.

state.description: Tri-state result: pass (predicate held), fail (predicate did not hold), not-run (check was declared but could not execute).

level.description: Proof-ladder rung this check contributes to (e.g. 'L4'). Mirrors CheckSpec.level from ready.yaml.

expect.description: The predicate expression declared for this check (e.g. 'db.orders.rows > @before').

observed.description: The actual observed value that was evaluated against the predicate (e.g. '42 > 17').

reason.description: Explanation for a fail or not-run result (e.g. 'gate: cluster deploy pending', 'exit code 1').

artifacts.description: Names of artifacts (matching Artifact.name) that provide evidence for this check's result.

Artifact.title: Artifact
Artifact.description: One captured file or link inside the bundle directory. Provenance distinguishes harness-collected from agent-supplied artifacts (anti-fabrication).

type.description: Artifact kind: command (captured shell command with exit code), snapshot (before/after data snapshot), screenshot (UI screenshot), log (free-form log file), recording (video/trace recording), link (external URL reference).

name.description: Short identifier for this artifact, used as a reference key in Check.artifacts. Must be unique within the bundle.

path.description: Relative path to the artifact file within the bundle directory (e.g. '03-fire.log'). For type 'link', this is the URL.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the artifact file. Omitted for type 'link'. Used for tamper-evidence.

provenance.description: Who produced this artifact (ADR-0013): 'harness' (teed subprocess captured by the pb harness), 'tool' (harness-directed external tool output — trace/screenshot the harness chose but did not tee), or 'agent' (supplied by the agent — requires scrutiny).

meta.description: Type-specific metadata. For 'command': cmd (string), exitCode (integer), durationSec (number). For 'snapshot': table (string), rowsBefore (integer), rowsAfter (integer). Other types may use free-form keys.
